text:
Dark phantoms,
somber clouds,
flee before the flash
of divine light.
That holy light,
girl with dark eyes,
is hope.

In the warmth of its rays,
my mighty faith
struggles against disdain
without growing less.
In this endeavor,
if the suffering is great,
the reward is greater.

And if you still show me,
elusive one, a soul of snow;
if you still do not love me,
I shall love you.
My love is a rock
against which the timid waves
of the sea break.

translation.title: Rhyme LXXXIII: Dark Phantoms
